aboutGame.title: What is Evolve a Cell?
paragraphs: Evolve a Cell is a free-to-play survival and growth game on Roblox where you play a single microscopic organism in a fluid environment. You swim, feed on nutrients, avoid larger cells, and convert everything you collect into permanent upgrades that carry your lineage forward.

Progression is the second layer: every run funds a longer evolution curve that unlocks new forms, faster movement, tougher membranes, and sharper senses. With no long tutorial and no penalty for restarting, the fastest way to improve is to learn the loop, bank your gains, and evolve deliberately.

modules.name: Evolve a Cell Beginner Guide
modules.description: Get new players started with the core loop: what to eat, which upgrades to buy first, and which threats to swim away from in your first few runs.

highlights.detail: Practice movement first so you learn your turning radius and how momentum carries your cell.
Eat static nutrients early; chasing fast prey wastes energy you do not have yet.
Avoid fights with anything larger than you and treat distance as a resource.
Bank your first mutation points until you know what is actually killing you.
Watch your energy bar before your health bar, since running dry kills faster than predators.
End the run on purpose and bank your progress instead of gambling it away.

modules.name: Evolve a Cell Evolution Guide
modules.description: Understand how cell evolution works, including the core systems, growth paths, and the progression decisions that shape every run.

highlights.label: Energy
highlights.detail: Every action has a cost, and running out of energy dissolves your cell mid-move.

highlights.label: Biomass
highlights.detail: Nutrients feed growth, unlock new structures, and raise your evolution ceiling.

highlights.label: Mutations
highlights.detail: Permanent trait upgrades that compound when you spend them on the right problem.

highlights.label: Defense
highlights.detail: Reinforced membranes and toxin resistance turn fatal hits into survivable ones.

highlights.label: Senses
highlights.detail: Sensory range lets you spot predators and rich zones before it is too late.

highlights.label: Offense
highlights.detail: Predation is the fastest growth path, but only once survival is already solved.

modules.name: Evolve a Cell Best Builds
modules.description: Compare recommended builds for different playstyles such as growth, defense, and survival, and learn which upgrade families are worth committing to.

highlights.label: Growth
highlights.detail: Stack resource-rate and absorption upgrades so every later purchase pays for itself.

highlights.label: Speed
highlights.detail: Movement and flagella upgrades make escaping and exploring cheaper than fighting.

highlights.label: Tank
highlights.detail: Membrane and defense builds trade speed for the durability to survive hostile zones.

highlights.label: Balanced
highlights.detail: A flexible hybrid keeps one slot open for whatever the next zone throws at you.

highlights.label: Storage
highlights.detail: Vacuoles and capacity upgrades let you ride out scarcity and bank before evolving.

highlights.label: Sensory
highlights.detail: Detection upgrades are the cheapest way to avoid ambushes and find rare spawns.

modules.name: Evolve a Cell Parts Tier List
modules.description: Rank the most important upgrades and evolution parts by how much they actually speed up a run, from must-buy multipliers to situational picks.

highlights.label: S
highlights.detail: Resource-rate and absorption multipliers, buy these first in every single run.

highlights.label: A
highlights.detail: Movement speed and stamina, since more ground covered means more resources per minute.

highlights.label: B
highlights.detail: Membrane defense and sensory range, strong once survival stops being the bottleneck.

highlights.label: C
highlights.detail: Size, mass, and cosmetic upgrades, powerful late, punishing early, and never urgent.

modules.name: Evolve a Cell Codes
modules.description: Track how Evolve a Cell codes work, where they are announced, and what rewards each type of code usually hands out.

highlights.label: Currency
highlights.detail: Soft-currency codes add spendable cash to your balance and can be redeemed any time.

highlights.label: XP Boost
highlights.detail: Growth and XP multipliers speed up evolution for a limited window, so redeem them before a long session.

highlights.label: DNA Bundle
highlights.detail: DNA and biomass bundles feed directly into evolution stages when you are stuck at a gate.

highlights.label: Cosmetics
highlights.detail: Skin, trail, and aura codes are purely visual flair and are worth grabbing last.

modules.name: Evolve a Cell Boss Guide
modules.description: Prepare for late-game fights with large creatures and bosses, including stage-by-stage growth, mutation priorities, and positioning tips.

highlights.detail: Secure mobility and sustain before raw damage, because escaping wins more early fights than burst.
Feed in a safe pocket so your upkeep never outruns your income between fights.
Clear the colony-to-hunter gate, where you must win fights without full combat tools.
Stack armor and burst damage together to win one-on-one encounters consistently.
Contest territory and break boss encounters once your economy can fund the attempt.
Bank a surplus before the apex-to-colossus transition so the upkeep spike never stalls you.

modules.name: Evolve a Cell Growth Guide
modules.description: Learn efficient ways to gather food, raise your income, and move out of the starter zone so your evolution compounds instead of stalling.

highlights.label: Gather
highlights.detail: Absorb nutrients and biomass in your current habitat to fund the next upgrade.

highlights.label: Convert
highlights.detail: Spend on gather-rate and efficiency upgrades before niche or cosmetic picks.

highlights.label: Unlock
highlights.detail: Meet the next evolutionary tier requirement instead of hoarding resources.

highlights.label: Repeat
highlights.detail: Rebuild at a higher baseline and re-buy your top two priorities first.

highlights.label: Zones
highlights.detail: Leave the starter area once you can survive comfortably, since low yield caps growth.

highlights.label: Timing
highlights.detail: Run focused twenty to thirty minute blocks and bank progress before you evolve.

modules.name: Evolve a Cell Tips and Tricks
modules.description: Practical habits that keep a run moving, from spending discipline and rate-first upgrades to the mistakes that quietly stall your evolution.

highlights.label: Rate First
highlights.detail: Buy upgrades that raise how fast your bar fills before flat stat boosts.

highlights.label: No Hoard
highlights.detail: A banked currency earns nothing, so spend up to the next meaningful breakpoint.

highlights.label: Automate
highlights.detail: Automation keeps producing while you idle and beats a one-time stat bump.

highlights.label: Compare
highlights.detail: Judge upgrades by time saved, not by the size of the number on the button.

highlights.label: Review
highlights.detail: Note what killed you each run and buy the trait that solves it next time.

highlights.label: Restart
highlights.detail: If the opening two minutes go badly, a quick restart beats recovering a broken build.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Evolve a Cell.

items.question: What is Evolve a Cell?
items.answer: Evolve a Cell is a free-to-play survival and growth game on Roblox where you play a single microscopic organism. You swim, feed on nutrients, avoid larger cells, and convert what you collect into permanent upgrades that unlock new forms and abilities.

items.question: Is Evolve a Cell free to play?
items.answer: Yes. Evolve a Cell is free to play on Roblox, and it has no long tutorial or penalty for restarting, so new players can learn the core loop through short practice runs.

items.question: What should I upgrade first in Evolve a Cell?
items.answer: Energy generation and digestion come before damage. In Evolve a Cell, a cell that cannot fund its own growth starves long before a predator ever reaches it.

items.question: How do I evolve faster in Evolve a Cell?
items.answer: Buy resource-rate and movement upgrades first, leave the starter zone once you can survive it comfortably, and bank a surplus before every evolution gate so your upkeep never outruns your income.

items.question: Do Evolve a Cell codes exist?
items.answer: Evolve a Cell codes are announced through the in-game code menu and the developer's official channels. Check those sources directly, redeem codes the moment you see them, and never trust generator sites.

items.question: How do I reach max evolution in Evolve a Cell?
items.answer: Keep your income rising at every step. In Evolve a Cell, stack compound multipliers, avoid spreading upgrades evenly, and re-check the tier requirements each session so you never hoard past a gate.
